description: HEAD says 200 but GET answers 500 with a css-looking body (a flaky origin): critical USES THE ERROR BODY as the stylesheet.

/wp-content/themes/twentytest/flaky.css.body:
/* 500 error body that looks like css */
.error-body{content:"500"}

thin.note: A failed stylesheet on the page's own host fails the whole job (decision: shipping critical css that silently lacks the owner's own rules is worse than shipping none). The error body is never used as css. (In these fixtures {{site}} and {{cdn}} share the hostname 127.0.0.1 and differ only by port: "same host" must compare host:port, as the url() rebasing does, or be injectable.)
